02 / CONNECT YOUR BROWSER

The companion stays on your computer.

Install once in desktop Chrome or Edge. It reads slots in your signed-in CGHS tab.

Download companion ZIP ↓
Installation & setup
  1. Unzip the download.
  2. Open chrome://extensions (or edge://extensions), enable Developer mode, and choose Load unpacked. Select the extracted folder containing manifest.json.
  3. Download your plan above. Open the SlotCare extension and import that JSON file.
  4. Sign in directly on CGHS. Select the intended family member, location, doctor, and date.
  5. In the on-page SlotCare panel, capture the four dropdowns, requested date button, a slot button, and Save. Capturing intercepts the click.
  6. Confirm the patient and press Start checking. Keep this tab open. Check the official receipt after any Save.

Plan JSON includes the beneficiary ID. Keep it private and delete it when no longer needed. The extension keeps imported details in browser-session memory.

CHECK ON A SCHEDULE

Keep an eye on booking availability.

Supabase Cron queues checks while this planner is closed. A running browser worker uses your CGHS session and pauses when login is needed. Deployment setup is required.

A SIMPLE PATH TO YOUR APPOINTMENT

Three steps. Less repetition.

01

Set your preferences

One beneficiary, one doctor, one date, and a time range that works for you.

02

Sign in on CGHS

Complete password, OTP, and any verification on the official portal. Connect the page controls once per session.

03

Check, then confirm

The companion checks green slots for up to 60 minutes. A CGHS appointment receipt confirms the booking.
